text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Digital didn't seem to be feeling well,
so I decided to let her rest in the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
If you'll excuse me, I'm going to sleep for a bit.
Good night...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"...Whaaaaat!?
Where am I? Did I get reincarnated into another world!?"

text_block_list.name: Clone A
text_block_list.text:
"Close! It wasn't an isekai reincarnation,
Digitan just split into clones~!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Uhyoo! That's me, isn't it?! A clone has appeared!! There's a ton over there too!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ah, so these windows floating in midair
are the visual feeds from your clones!

text_block_list.name: Clone A
text_block_list.text: So, what's the first thing you do when you can make clones of yourself?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Doing a live performance with all the Umamusume is the ONLY choice!!

text_block_list.name: Clone A
text_block_list.text: I see, multiple angles, indeed!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
A panoramic view from the rear seats, plus long, medium, and close-up shots
from front stage right, stage left, and dead center!
Muhooo~~! Simply irresistible!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
And from atop the stage, seeing it with my own eyes!
Self-controlled multi-angle views are the abso-lute best~~!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: My eyes... My eyes are completely enoughhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: ...H-Huh? A dream...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
At least the memory of the concert footage is crystal clear!
Hehehe, time to replay it over and over in my head~âª

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With her spirits revitalized, Agnes Digital seemed to have regained her form!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Training, watching discs, reading magazines,
homework, writing manuscripts, organizing merch...
If we divide it all up, it'll be done in a flash!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Then first, I'll take care of the training—

text_block_list.name: Clone A
text_block_list.text:
Digitan wants training too!!
I wanna catch side glances of the other Uma Musumes' youth while working out!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: In that case, I shall switch to manuscript writing—

text_block_list.name: Clone B
text_block_list.text:
Hold on!! I've got my own surging pathos
that I want to turn into a book,
so I'm not backing down!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ah, jeez, we're not splitting up the work at all!
Digitan really wants to do it all herse—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ah... what, it was just a dream...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Huuuhm...
I feel as though I've had my own greed laid bare before me...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Tossed about by her dreams, Agnes Digital didn't seem able to get back into top form...
